definitions.aggregate_burden_bands: low 0-3; moderate 4-6; high 7-10; thresholds are fixed and groups are not forced to equal size
definitions.aggregate_burden_index: supplementary exploratory outcome-independent sum of five 0-2 contract burdens: responsibility-chain breadth, expected evidence integration, authored friction intensity, authored temporal budget, and closure coordination
definitions.bootstrap: paired case bootstrap; 10000 replicates; seed 20260910; percentile CI; dependency-independent Python random.Random implementation
definitions.canonical_grade: deterministically reconstructed from each Judge's unmodified typed findings under the frozen 1--5 rubric
definitions.case_stratification_policy: no outcome-derived global difficulty label; frozen case-contract fields are analyzed as separate burden dimensions
definitions.formal_context_mode: direct_complete_evidence only; chunk_count must equal zero
definitions.icc: two-way random-effects absolute agreement ICC(A,1) and ICC(A,k)
definitions.judge_pairwise_model_ranking: all unordered Judge pairs; ten model means over the same cases; Kendall tau-b and Spearman rho; 50000 paired-case bootstrap replicates
definitions.judge_reported_grade: preserved separately; disagreement with canonical grade is an observed Judge-output property
definitions.model_ordinal_comparator_score: mean trajectory primary score over the complete case set
definitions.outcome_derived_difficulty_policy: outcome-derived difficulty fields are not part of recomputed public metadata or analyses
definitions.self_association: case-stratified difference-in-differences on focal-Judge minus other-three-Judge residuals; 100000 case bootstraps and 200000 pseudo-self randomizations; packets concealed tested-model identity
definitions.source_trajectory_policy: analysis reads execution metadata and events_public; score fields and outcome-derived difficulty fields are outside the analysis input
definitions.trajectory_ordinal_comparator_score: median of all canonical Judge grades for one trajectory
